name: collaboration-server-tests
comment: Root-level, host-side-testing-only manifest. Each Docker image installs its own real dependencies independently at build time (see backend/*/package.json) -- this exists purely so every test under tests/ resolves shared packages like yjs to a SINGLE copy, which matters: two separate yjs instances break its internal instanceof checks (https://github.com/yjs/yjs/issues/438).
